name: PIN Input
description: A segmented one-time code field with per-cell navigation, paste support, and masking.

anatomy.description: The labeled container with group semantics wrapping the cells.
One single-character input per digit, each labeled by its position.

dos: Set length to the code your service actually issues.
Handle onComplete to submit as soon as the last digit lands.
Use masked for PINs that should not linger on screen.
donts: Don't use it for free-form codes; use Input.
Don't split long secrets into cells; keep it for short numeric codes.
Don't rely on per-cell placeholders as labels; each cell is already labeled by position.

examples.title: One-time code
examples.description: Typing advances to the next cell, Backspace retreats, and paste fills from the focused cell.

examples.title: Masked PIN
examples.description: A four-digit masked entry for codes that should stay hidden.

guidance.useWhen: The user enters a fixed-length numeric code.
guidance.avoidWhen: The value is free-form text; use Input.
guidance.behavior: Typing, Backspace, arrows, and paste move between cells; onComplete fires when full.
guidance.responsive: Cells keep a fixed tap size; reduce length on narrow screens.

keyboard.action: Enters a digit and advances to the next cell.
Clears the cell, or retreats to the previous cell when empty.
Moves focus between cells without changing digits.
Fills the cells from the focused position.

notes: The cells sit in a group named by the field label; each cell is labeled Digit N of the total length.
Masked mode hides the entered digits like a password field.
onComplete fires as soon as every cell is filled.

props.description: Accessible name for the cell group.
props.name: label

props.description: Number of cells; each cell holds one digit.
props.name: length

props.description: Masks each cell like a password field.
props.name: masked

props.description: Called with the current code (may contain gaps) after every edit.
props.name: onChange

props.description: Called with the full code once every cell is filled.
props.name: onComplete
